title: OJOFScenarioSpec
description: Schema contract for OJOF LookML multi-fact evaluation scenario specifications.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the scenario specification.

title.description: Human-readable title of the evaluation scenario.

description.description: Detailed summary of the scenario domain and modeling requirements.

dataset.description: Target BigQuery dataset name or public dataset reference.

anchor_date.description: Optional anchor date for overriding relative date functions (e.g. '2026-08-31').

architecturePrompt.description: Primary prompt sent to the agent describing the explore design objective without dictating table schemas.

userQuestions.description: Dictionary of test questions evaluated against the generated LookML model.

supported.description: Whether the question should be supported by the LookML model.

prompt.description: User question or dashboard query requirement prompt.

minDimensions.description: Minimum count of dimensions expected in the query.

minMeasures.description: Minimum count of aggregate measures expected in the query.

minFilters.description: Minimum count of filters expected in the query.

expectedSqlAggregates.description: SQL aggregate functions expected in the compiled SQL (e.g. SUM, COUNT, COUNT_DISTINCT, AVG).

expectedDimensions.description: Expected dimensions or groupings in the query.

expectedMeasures.description: Expected aggregate measure concepts in the query.

participatingColumns.description: List of physical database columns (table.column) expected in the compiled SQL.

tables.description: Optional table definitions used by synthetic data generators. Omitted for pre-existing datasets.
